name: Prisma Grakata
tradeable: unranked only, no Forma or Catalyst

groups.activity: crack Void Relics, trade Prime parts for Ducats
groups.mode: squad of four for more reward picks

rows.label: Ducats
rows.note: trade Prime parts and blueprints at any Relay Ducat Kiosk except Maroo's Bazaar

conditions: The kiosk is open even when Baro isn't there, so bank Ducats ahead of his visit; his window is only 48 hours.
Bronze parts are worth 15 ducats, silver 45, gold 100 (25/65 for parts demoted from vaulted relics); 610 is about six gold parts and a bronze.
bonuses: Capture and Exterminate on fast tilesets run under two minutes; Defense cracks a relic every wave and drops more relics.
Baro's once-per-visit Void Surplus (50,000 credits) has a 2% chance of 1,000 Ducats.

disclosures.title: where not to get ducats
disclosures.body: Aya to Ducats at Varzia during Prime Resurgence is 5 ducats per Aya, a poor rate useful only for leftover Aya.

rows.label: Prisma Grakata
rows.note: arrives built and ready to equip; no Foundry step
rows.alt: or a TennoCon relay visit with Baro's Relay Ticket

conditions: Baro's stock changes every visit; the Prisma Grakata appears a few times a year, sometimes with gaps of several months.
MR 11 is needed to equip it, and to receive it in a trade.
